deviations: envoy-infra-v2.6.0 (tag at 819dc283d) released appPriorityClassName after the plan was written, so the rename to priorityClassName now renames a released input. Per plan T10's branch for that case, the CHANGELOG keeps the released entry and records the rename in the Breaking entry; the release is a major bump anyway. Expected release: envoy-infra-v3.0.0.

T9.2 (SetKeepAlivesEnabled(false) at shutdown) is not added: Go's Server.Shutdown already writes every response with Connection: close (net/http server.go doKeepAlives includes shuttingDown). TestServerClosesConnectionsAfterShutdownBegins records that fact through newHTTPServer.

Spec items BG-11 and BG-12 (added by the INFRA-63 architect, 04:02Z): proxyCpu/proxyMemory inputs, default 1 CPU / 2Gi (the cloud-sql-proxy v2.26.3 sidecar example); default databaseTier db-custom-4-15360 (max_connections 500 holds six server pods of 82 connections, so 5 replicas rolling); pool.go comment fixed.
Liveness and startup probes use a new /livez endpoint rather than /healthz (simplify pass finding): /healthz on the listener can exceed curl's 8 s on a slow hub and would restart it.
The advertiser container is named advertiser, not cert-order: it advertises, recovers a stuck advertisement, orders the certificate and writes the ready file.
